items.source: Creates a new BeforeDeleteEvent for the given Document, type and collectionName.
items.translation: 为给定的Document、类型和集合名称创建一个新的BeforeDeleteEvent。

items.source: Event being thrown before a document is deleted. The Document held in the event will represent the query document before being mapped based on the domain class handled.
items.translation: 在删除文档之前抛出的事件。该事件中持有的 Document 代表在根据所处理的领域类进行映射之前的查询文档。

items.source: Martin Baumgartner, Christoph Strobl, Mark Paluch
